author: ClubberNugget
body:
Hello Avicus Staff,

This is not an appeal for myself, but for a friend who cannot access their forums account.

Their IGN: AddexDLG (originally addex05)
Reason for ban: Hacking - Kill aura (April 26, 2015 at 11:25 AM) by Kammeh
why they should be unbanned: This is what Addex said to me, "I got banned because someone thought that I was hacking even though I wasn't nor would I ever, besides i don't even know how to install mods or texture packs, so please tell a mod or staff that I wasn't hacking!" So could the evidence be presented for this? Plus It's been nine months, so I think this user should be appealed. Thanks for your time, ~Random
